steps.name: Ad shown
steps.description: One paid ad impression served to someone on an ads network (Google Ads, and any future Meta or LinkedIn ads channel). The money for it is already charged by the network; a share of impressions turn into a website visit.

steps.name: Audience built
steps.description: A target list built for a client: an audience, or a new source (buying signal, competitor posts) added to one. Rate measured: 157 of 807 lists built in 90 days reached at least one lead.

steps.name: Booking call
steps.description: A sales rep calls the buyer by phone, right after they replied with interest, to book the meeting.

steps.name: Company researched
steps.description: A prospect's company website read, reused for every lead of that company. Every research run feeds a message.

steps.name: Positive reply
steps.description: A buyer answers with interest, on whatever medium the channel runs on.

steps.name: Email checked
steps.description: A verifier's verdict on an email (valid, catch-all or unknown kept; invalid is a loss carried by the kept ones). Rate measured: 33,498 leads served over 39,941 kept verdicts (90 days).

steps.name: Email found
steps.description: A work email found for a person. Rate measured: 39,941 kept over 44,679 verdicts (90 days).

steps.name: Email sent
steps.description: An email you wrote is sent to the person, from our domains and inboxes.

steps.name: Form submitted
steps.description: A buyer fills a form and hands over their details, either on the brand's own site or on a form hosted by the ad platform.

steps.name: Industry update video
steps.description: A person engages with our daily industry update video (likes, comments or reposts it).

steps.name: Lead
steps.description: A person who matches your target is found, with a verified email.

steps.name: Lead identified
steps.description: A person who fits the target, with no way to reach them yet. Rate measured: 28,098 emails over 28,445 enrichments (90 days).

steps.name: Meeting attended
steps.description: The booked meeting is actually held, with the buyer in the room.

steps.name: Meeting booked
steps.description: A buyer takes a slot in the calendar. Nobody has met yet.

steps.name: Message sent
steps.description: A message we sent one person, on any channel; each follow-up is one more. Rate measured: 29 positive repliers over 27,603 cold email sends (90 days).

steps.name: Message written
steps.description: A message written for one person, on any channel. Rate measured: 27,603 sends over 30,558 writing runs (90 days).

steps.name: Paid client
steps.description: A buyer pays. This is the SALE every funnel terminates in.

steps.name: Phone found
steps.description: A phone number found for a person. Every reveal runs inside a serve.

steps.name: Post published
steps.description: One post, quote, reshare or comment published on X or LinkedIn, by the daily industry presence or the Social post channel. Produced by social-service; the subject is its record of that publication. Toward rate measured 2026-10-25: 55 of 84 published items (2026-10-02 to 10-24) drew at least one like, reply, repost or quote.

steps.name: Direct purchase
steps.description: A buyer pays at checkout on the brand's own site. No account needed.

steps.name: Signup
steps.description: A buyer creates an account on the brand's own product, without paying yet.

steps.name: Website visit
steps.description: A buyer lands on the brand's own website.
